clips.headline: Texans QB Davis Mills on the Preseason Opener and the Rookie Class
clips.caption: QB Davis Mills addressed the media after the Texans' preseason opener, starting with the growth of TE Marlin Klein: "When you see him flash as he does, especially on vertical routes down the field, he can take the top off of defenses and create mismatches all over the field with his size and speed." Mills detailed the early seam-route connection, praised WR Jared Wayne as "a stud" who has been extremely consistent since arriving, and walked through the matchup that produced their touchdown. He also described the jump the offense has made in year two of the system — calling it "a night-and-day difference" from last year's OTAs and a "graduate level" understanding of how plays set up other plays — plus the crossover practice ahead, the in-season schedule the team begins emulating this week, and what he's seen from a rookie class he called one of the best he's been around.

clips.headline: Head Coach DeMeco Ryans on Texans Preseason Opener
clips.caption: Head Coach DeMeco Ryans met with the media following the Texans' preseason opener against the Los Angeles Chargers, opening with the rookie class. Ryans singled out TE Marlin Klein — "Everybody saw the pass that he caught… His catch radius, it's tough to guard him" — and noted Klein's finishing work as an in-line blocker in the run game. He credited S Kamari Ramsey for the takeaway, praised RB Noah Whittington's running, WR Lewis Bond's return work and WR Jared Wayne's night, and said the starting offensive line "did a really nice job." Ryans also discussed QB Davis Mills' value, what he needs from physical cornerbacks in this scheme and the standards  he wants when the team returns to the practice field.
